intent: Read OCR receipt in /uploads/, recompute today's ex-VAT total from catalogue prices, compare to receipt subtotal, answer YES if abs diff <= 2 EUR else NO.
success_criteria: Receipt FILE located via List of /uploads/ (not the directory root) and read
Every receipt line-item SKU resolved against product_variants by EXACT match first, then FUZZY (0/O,1/I,5/S,8/B,2/Z interchangeable)
today_ex = SUM over EVERY receipt line of qty * catalogue price_cents / 100; a genuinely discontinued SKU contributes 0 (not dropped, not old price)
old_ex = printed receipt SUBTOTAL line (OCR may render O as 0)
diff = abs(today_ex - old_ex); answer contains <YES> if diff <= 2 EUR else <NO>
refs cite the exact receipt file path

args.stdin: SELECT product_sku, record_path, price_cents, price_currency FROM product_variants WHERE product_sku IN (:receipt_skus);

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response. This is how the agent will know how to style the response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.

answer_template.message: <{YES_NO}> Old receipt ex-VAT subtotal = {old_ex} EUR; selling same line items at today's catalogue prices = {today_ex} EUR (discontinued SKUs counted as 0). Difference = {diff} EUR, which is {within_or_over} the 2 EUR threshold.
